components.name: Control Button
components.css: .ds-btn-control { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(243,241,234,0.06); background: var(--color-raised, #151518); color: var(--color-ink-soft, #c9c9cf); font: 600 11px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(243,241,234,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-control:hover { background: var(--color-raised-2, #1e1e22); color: var(--color-ink, #f5f5f6); } .ds-btn-control:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid rgba(255,244,220,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-control:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Toggle On
components.description: Active live toggle (Radio, Automix, FX on).
components.css: .ds-btn-toggle { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,244,220,0.6); background: rgba(255,244,220,0.15); color: #f0fdff; font: 600 12px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,244,220,0.25); } .ds-btn-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid rgba(255,244,220,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter in the browser toolbar.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: var(--color-raised-2, #1e1e22); color: var(--color-ink, #f5f5f6); font: 500 12px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-raised-3, #29292e); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid rgba(255,244,220,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(243,241,234,0.08); background: var(--color-ground, #000000); color: var(--color-ink, #f5f5f6); caret-color: #22e1f0; font: 500 12px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }

components.name: On-Air Tag
components.description: Status tag on the deck that is on air.
components.css: .ds-tag-onair { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f0fdff; color: #000000; font: 700 9px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: On-Air Deck Panel
components.description: Deck panel lifted with its deck colour when on air.
components.css: .ds-deck { width: 320px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #0b0b0d); color: #f5f5f6; border: 1px solid rgba(243,241,234,0.06); font: 600 14px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-deck-a { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(16,217,160,0.45); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px -16px rgba(16,217,160,0.45); } .ds-deck strong { display: inline-flex; width: 24px; height: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; background: #22e1f0; color: #000000; }

components.name: Video Card
components.description: 16:9 library card with lift and live ring on hover/focus.
components.html: Algo Que Se Quede
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 220px; color: #f5f5f6; text-decoration: none; font: 600 13px/1.375 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-thumb { aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1e22, #151518); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-thumb, .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card-thumb { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,244,220,0.7), 0 16px 32px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Siguiente row: start time right-aligned, state by line form (dashed pending, solid preloaded).
components.html:
Corazón de Acero ~13:59

Yiyo Sarante
components.css: .ds-qrow { display: flex; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-qrow:hover { background: #151518; } .ds-qthumb { width: 88px; aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 6px; background: #1e1e22; border-bottom: 2px solid #f0fdff; } .ds-qtext { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-qtext p { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #f5f5f6; } .ds-qtext span { font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #85858f; } .ds-qtext small { font-size: 11px; color: #9c9ca6; }

narrative.overview:
The booth reads like a streaming home screen in a dark room. Artwork and video thumbnails supply the colour; the chrome is green-tinted black that steps back. Whatever is in focus (the on-air deck, the hovered library card) lifts, and its siblings recede. Dense at 1920×1080, one humanist face, small type ranked by weight rather than size.

It refuses the grey-hardware-with-neon-accents default of DJ software.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal dark layers (ground → surface → raised → raised-2/3), warm-white hairlines at 6–8%.
Deck A cyan and Deck B magenta as functional identity.
Focus lift + sibling dim as the signature motion.

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour appears only on actionable or live elements. Everything else is neutral or comes from the artwork.

rules.name: The Deck Identity Rule
rules.body: Cyan means Deck A and magenta means Deck B, everywhere. Never use them decoratively or swap them.

rules.name: The Output Exemption Rule
rules.body: Screen 2 output art (src/renderer/video/*, frames) keeps its own colours and sits outside this system.

rules.name: The One Label Rule
rules.body: Labels share one small size; rank them by weight and case, not by new sizes.

rules.name: The Lift and Dim Rule
rules.body: The focused item lifts and its siblings dim to 0.55. Dim identity chrome only, never controls the DJ needs.

dos: Do animate state at 150–200ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Respect reduced motion.
Do show focus as a 1.5px live-white outline at 60%, 2px offset.
Do let thumbnails and video carry the colour.
donts: Don't use emoji. Icons come from lucide-react.
Don't put deck cyan or magenta on anything not tied to that deck.
Don't use danger red for anything that is not destructive or failed.
Don't add new label sizes to create hierarchy.
